{"invites":[{"spec_id":"spec_0361","text":"Vikram, Victor, forwarding this so it's on your calendars. Sorry for the short notice, I only just saw it. I'm a little nervous we're not ready. The vendor says this is mostly them walking through the new attendance module screens and the pricing sheet for renewal under the Moreau account. They also said the slides and a recorded version go out to everyone afterward anyway. I don't think they need anything from us. But Fatima asked us to "have eyes on it" before the board packet goes out, so here we are.

Also, I can't tell if 2:00 is our time or theirs. Their office is on Pacific and the invite just says "2:00 PM." Outlook shows it as 2:00 for me, but Arjun's copy showed 5:00. Can someone double check before Thursday? I really don't want us to miss it or show up three hours early.

---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: Ines Thorne
Subject: Product Walkthrough – Attendance & Notifications Update
To: Vera; Vikram Bakshi; Victor Achterberg

Hello Maplevale Public Schools team,

Thank you for your continued partnership. We'd love to show you what's new ahead of your renewal.

When: Thursday, 2:00 PM – 2:30 PM
Where: Video link to follow

Rough agenda:
- Overview of the redesigned attendance dashboard (10 min)
- New parent text notification options (10 min)
- Renewal pricing summary for the Moreau account (5 min)
- Questions (5 min)

A recording and the full deck will be shared after the session for anyone who can't attend.

Best,
Ines Thorne
